intro: Football is the most popular sport in Malta, followed by water polo.

chapters.title: Football
text: Maltese fans passionately follow English and Italian clubs as well as their own national team.

chapters.title: Water polo and more
text: Water polo is played in summer in harbour pools, and horse racing with trotting horses draws crowds at Marsa.

keyTerms.meaning: Horse racing where horses pull a light cart.
